name: Yuuki's Party Night
source:
A short fun visual novel, following Yuuki as she goes on her first night out for a long time, to an outdoor costume party no less.

Will Yuuki meet a new friend or find someone special in her life?
Or simply have one hell of a night?!
It is up to you as you make key decisions in this multi route visual novel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/973550/]Steam[/url]]
